description: devspeak anti-patterns for gate + agent enforcement

forbidden.name: em_dash
forbidden.message: em/en dash forbidden- use hyphen attach (word- next)

forbidden.name: spaced_hyphen
forbidden.message: spaced hyphen forbidden- use attach hyphen (word- next)

warn.name: emoji_flood
warn.message: emojis sparse only- visual markers not decoration

warn.name: semicolon_wall
warn.message: bullet too long- cluster then nest sub-bullets

warn.name: semicolon_cram
warn.message: too many semicolons- split or nest

warn.name: bold_flood
warn.message: bold sparingly- keywords and demos only

warn.name: bullet_essay_opener
warn.message: lowercase bullet start- cap only genuine proper noun/acronym in context

warn.name: essay_transition
warn.regex: \b(it is important to note|this means that|in conclusion|furthermore|additionally)\b
warn.message: not essay- use if/then logic flow

warn.name: lowercase_bold_section_heading
warn.message: bold section labels (heading role) capitalize first word
